Alias apexhospitalitygrouplv.org -> deployment dpl_6FrFUKmNwrQRP7JzaYJaz9pzns7q, state READY, target production, github commit 713e9e5ff75b793fa9118ea150124b05596240cd on main. DNS A -> 216.198.79.1. status.domainConnectedEvidence: 2026-09-24 via Vercel API: apexhospitalitygrouplv.org listed on project apex-content-os (prj_PLOBCSNA2M7MNPhxkImNbE1A9xs8) with verified=true, and aliased to the current READY production deployment. DNS A -> 216.198.79.1 (a Vercel address, not Namecheap parking 192.64.119.87), unchanged since 2026-09-17. OPEN DEFECT: www.apexhospitalitygrouplv.org is verified and aliased in Vercel but has NO DNS record of any type (NXDOMAIN, re-measured 2026-09-24). The www form therefore fails DNS resolution entirely, and the TLS certificate does not cover it. One DNS record at Namecheap fixes it, using the value shown on the Vercel domain card. Not a critical blocker: every canonical URL on the site is the apex form.
status.emailProvider: Namecheap Private Email (mx1/mx2.privateemail.com) - NOT the free eforward forwarding used by the retired domain
status.emailEvidence: UNVERIFIED for this address - never tested until now, and the previous evidence here was misattributed. 2026-09-17 measured: MX apexhospitalitygrouplv.org -> mx1.privateemail.com, mx2.privateemail.com (pref 10); SPF v=spf1 include:spf.privateemail.com ~all; no DMARC record. A live owner test was sent 2026-09-17 18:51Z to hello@apexhospitalitygrouplv.org and produced NO bounce at all - checked again 2026-09-18, past the ~48h window in which Gmail issues a final non-delivery report - versus a 4-second bounce on the old domain. The message was accepted and delivered. Delivery into a real mailbox is still unconfirmed, because Private Email is a separate inbox from the owner's Gmail and cannot be read from this session. The '554 5.7.1 Relay access denied from eforward1.registrar-servers.com' bounce dated 2026-09-13 belongs to hello@apexcontentstudio.online - the retired domain on free forwarding - and was previously recorded against this address in error.
status.httpsEvidence: 2026-09-24 against Vercel's certificate store, not a browser padlock check. Certificate cert_qGQRlrI7ibAfGPB8mQQCoPq9, common name apexhospitalitygrouplv.org, issued 2026-09-15, expires 2026-12-14, autoRenew true. Vercel serves aliases over HTTPS only and the domain is aliased to the current READY production deployment. Scope: the certificate covers the apex only, www is not a subject of it. A direct handshake from this session proves nothing, because the egress gateway re-terminates TLS and presents its own certificate (issuer 'Anthropic / Egress Gateway SDS Issuing CA'); an HTTP request through it returns 403 host_not_allowed. An owner browser padlock check is still the only end-to-end confirmation.
status.formSubmissionEvidence: UNVERIFIED end to end. The form passes full validation, honeypot, focus and error-state checks in Chromium against the deployed tree, and api.web3forms.com is also egress-blocked from this session, so no live submission has been made.

status._gate: Read by tools/launch-gate.mjs. Every gate must be literally true before the outreach pipeline will run msg, contact, followup or proposal. null means unverified, and unverified holds the line. criticalBlocker: null when clear, otherwise a sentence naming what is wrong.

workspace._comment: Google Workspace account record - SEPARATE from the published mailbox. The earlier note here described Namecheap forwarding into the Google Workspace inbox, which is the retired domain's architecture, not this one. primaryDomain below is the Workspace domain the owner account sits on; docs/dns-audit.md records the open question of whether its spelling is intended. verificationTxt is the Google site-verification token - status.googleDomainVerified and status.googleTxtPublished remain false until the owner confirms publication.
